text.WLC: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃
text.SYN: Сказал Господь Господу моему: седи одесную Меня, доколе положу врагов Твоих в подножие ног Твоих.
text.NEO: Au maître de chant. Psaume de David.
text.NAB: For the leader. A psalm of David.
text.CEI: Al maestro del coro. Di Davide. Salmo. Dio della mia lode, non tacere,
text.LXX: Εἰς τὸ τέλος· τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. Ὁ θεός, τὴν αἴνεσίν μου μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς·
text.VUL: In finem. Psalmus David.
text.DRA: Unto the end, a psalm for David.

text.WLC: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
text.SYN: Жезл силы Твоей пошлет Господь с Сиона: господствуй среди врагов Твоих.
text.NEO: Car la bouche du méchant, la bouche du perfide, s’ouvre contre moi. Ils parlent contre moi avec une langue de mensonge,
text.NAB: O God, whom I praise, do not be silent, for wicked and treacherous mouths attack me. They speak against me with lying tongues;
text.VAT_ES: porque unos hombres malvados y mentirosos
text.CEI: poiché contro di me si sono aperte la bocca dell'empio e dell'uomo di frode; parlano di me con lingua di menzogna.
text.LXX: ὅτι στόμα ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ στόμα δολίου ἐπ’ ἐμὲ ἠνοίχθη, ἐλάλησαν κατ’ ἐμοῦ γλώσσῃ δολίᾳ·
text.VUL: Deus, laudem meam ne tacueris, quia os peccatoris et os dolosi super me apertum est.
text.DRA: O God, be not thou silent in thy praise: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.

text.WLC: וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃
text.SYN: В день силы Твоей народ Твой готов во благолепии святыни; из чрева прежде денницы подобно росе рождение Твое.
text.NEO: ils m’assiègent de paroles haineuses, et ils me font la guerre sans motif.
text.NAB: with hateful words they surround me, attacking me without cause.
text.VAT_ES: me han envuelto con palabras de odio,
text.CEI: Mi investono con parole di odio, mi combattono senza motivo.
text.LXX: καὶ λόγοις μίσους ἐκύκλωσάν με, καὶ ἐπολέμησάν με δωρεάν.
text.VUL: Locuti sunt adversum me lingua dolosa, et sermonibus odii circumdederunt me : et expugnaverunt me gratis.
text.DRA: They have spoken against with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; and have fought against me without cause.

text.WLC: תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִ֥י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּנִי וַאֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה׃
text.SYN: Клялся Господь и не раскается: Ты священник вовек по чину Мелхиседека.
text.NEO: En retour de mon affection, ils me combattent, et moi, je ne fais que prier.
text.NAB: In return for my love they slander me, even though I prayed for them.
text.VAT_ES: Me acusan, a cambio de mi amor,
text.CEI: In cambio del mio amore mi muovono accuse, mentre io sono in preghiera.
text.LXX: ἀντὶ τοῦ ἀγαπᾷν με ἐνδιέβαλλόν με, ἐγὼ δὲ προσευχόμην·
text.VUL: Pro eo ut me diligerent, detrahebant mihi ; ego autem orabam.
text.DRA: Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: but I gave myself to prayer.

text.WLC: וַיָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽי׃
text.SYN: Господь одесную Тебя. Он в день гнева Своего поразит царей;
text.NEO: Ils me rendent le mal pour le bien, et la haine pour l’amour.
text.NAB: They repay me evil for good, hatred for my love. My enemies say of me:
text.VAT_ES: Me devuelven mal por bien
text.CEI: Mi rendono male per bene e odio in cambio di amore.
text.LXX: καὶ ἔθεντο κατ’ ἐμοῦ κακὰ ἀντὶ ἀγαθῶν, καὶ μῖσος ἀντὶ τῆς ἀγαπήσεώς μου.
text.VUL: Et posuerunt adversum me mala pro bonis, et odium pro dilectione mea.
text.DRA: And they repaid me evil for good: and hatred for my love.

text.WLC: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣יו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל יְמִינֽוֹ׃
text.SYN: совершит суд над народами, наполнит _землю_ трупами, сокрушит голову в земле обширной.
text.NEO: Mets-le au pouvoir d’un méchant, et que l’accusateur se tienne à sa droite !
text.NAB: "Find a lying witness, an accuser to stand by his right hand,
text.VAT_ES: «Que se ponga contra él a un impío,
text.CEI: Suscita un empio contro di lui e un accusatore stia alla sua destra.
text.LXX: κατάστησον ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἁμαρτωλόν, καὶ διάβολος στήτω ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ·
text.VUL: Constitue super eum peccatorem, et diabolus stet a dextris ejus.
text.DRA: Set thou the sinner over him: and may the devil stand at his right hand.

text.WLC: בְּ֭הִשָּׁ֣פְטוֹ יֵצֵ֣א רָשָׁ֑ע וּ֝תְפִלָּת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַֽחֲטָאָֽה׃
text.SYN: Из потока на пути будет пить, и потому вознесет главу.
text.NEO: Quand on le jugera, qu’il sorte coupable, et que sa prière soit réputée péché !
text.NAB: That he may be judged and found guilty, that his plea may be in vain.
text.VAT_ES: que salga condenado del juicio
text.CEI: Citato in giudizio, risulti colpevole e il suo appello si risolva in condanna.
text.LXX: ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαι αὐτὸν ἐξέλθοι καταδεδικασμένος, καὶ ἡ προσευχὴ αὐτοῦ γενέσθω εἰς ἁμαρτίαν.
text.VUL: Cum judicatur, exeat condemnatus ; et oratio ejus fiat in peccatum.
text.DRA: When he is judged, may he go out condemned; and may his prayer be turned to sin.

text.WLC: יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָ֥יו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר׃
text.NEO: Que ses jours soient abrégés, et qu’un autre prenne sa charge !
text.NAB: May his days be few; may another take his office.
text.VAT_ES: Que sean pocos sus días
text.CEI: Pochi siano i suoi giorni e il suo posto l'occupi un altro.
text.LXX: γενηθήτωσαν αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὀλίγαι, καὶ τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λάβοι ἕτερος·
text.VUL: Fiant dies ejus pauci, et episcopatum ejus accipiat alter.
text.DRA: May his days be few: and his bishopric let another take.

text.WLC: יִֽהְיוּ בָנָ֥יו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝אִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָֽה׃
text.NEO: Que ses enfants deviennent orphelins, que son épouse soit veuve !
text.NAB: May his children be fatherless, his wife, a widow.
text.VAT_ES: que sus hijos queden huérfanos,
text.CEI: I suoi figli rimangano orfani e vedova sua moglie.
text.LXX: γενηθήτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ὀρφανοί, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ χήρα·
text.VUL: Fiant filii ejus orphani, et uxor ejus vidua.
text.DRA: May his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

text.WLC: וְנ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣יו וְשִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
text.NEO: Que ses enfants soient vagabonds et mendiants, cherchant leur pain loin de leurs maisons en ruines !
text.NAB: May his children be vagrant beggars, driven from their hovels.
text.VAT_ES: Que sus hijos vayan errantes, pidiendo limosna,
text.CEI: Vadano raminghi i suoi figli, mendicando, siano espulsi dalle loro case in rovina.
text.LXX: σαλευόμενοι μεταναστήτωσαν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπαιτησάτωσαν, ἐκβληθήτωσαν ἐκ τῶν οἰκοπέδων αὐτῶν.
text.VUL: Nutantes transferantur filii ejus et mendicent, et ejiciantur de habitationibus suis.
text.DRA: Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; and let them be cast out of their dwellings.

text.WLC: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְכָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽוֹ׃
text.NEO: Que le créancier s’empare de tout ce qui est à lui, et que les étrangers pillent ce qu’il a gagné par son travail !
text.NAB: May the usurer snare all he owns, strangers plunder all he earns.
text.VAT_ES: que el acreedor se apodere de sus bienes,
text.CEI: L'usuraio divori tutti i suoi averi e gli estranei faccian preda del suo lavoro.
text.LXX: καὶ ἐξεραυνησάτω δανιστὴς πάντα ὅσα ὑπάρχει αὐτῷ· διαρπασάτωσαν ἀλλότριοι πάντας τοὺς πόνους αὐτοῦ·
text.VUL: Scrutetur fœnerator omnem substantiam ejus, et diripiant alieni labores ejus.
text.DRA: May the userer search all his substance: and let strangers plunder his labours.

text.WLC: אַל יְהִי ל֭וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִיתוֹמָֽיו׃
text.NEO: Qu’il n’ait personne qui lui garde son affection, que nul n’ait pitié de ses orphelins !
text.NAB: May no one treat him kindly or pity his fatherless children.
text.VAT_ES: Que ni uno solo le tenga piedad,
text.CEI: Nessuno gli usi misericordia, nessuno abbia pietà dei suoi orfani.
text.LXX: μὴ ὑπαρξάτω αὐτῷ ἀντιλήμπτωρ, μηδὲ γενηθήτω οἰκτίρμων τοῖς ὀρφανοῖς αὐτοῦ·
text.VUL: Non sit illi adjutor, nec sit qui misereatur pupillis ejus.
text.DRA: May there be none to help him: nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.

text.WLC: יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥וֹ לְהַכְרִ֑ית בְּד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽם׃
text.NEO: Que ses descendants soient voués à la ruine, et que leur nom soit effacé à la seconde génération !
text.NAB: May his posterity be destroyed, his name cease in the next generation.
text.VAT_ES: que su posteridad sea exterminada,
text.CEI: La sua discendenza sia votata allo sterminio, nella generazione che segue sia cancellato il suo nome.
text.LXX: γενηθήτω τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ εἰς ἐξολέθρευσιν, ἐν γενεᾷ μιᾷ ἐξαλειφθήτω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: Fiant nati ejus in interitum ; in generatione una deleatur nomen ejus.
text.DRA: May his posterity be cut off; in one generation may his name be blotted out.

text.WLC: יִזָּכֵ֤ר עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָיו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְחַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗וֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח׃
text.NEO: Que l’iniquité de ses pères reste en souvenir devant Yahweh, et que la faute de leur mère ne soit pas effacée !
text.NAB: May the LORD remember his fathers' guilt; his mother's sin not be canceled.
text.VAT_ES: Que el Señor recuerde la culpa de sus padres,
text.CEI: L'iniquità dei suoi padri sia ricordata al Signore, il peccato di sua madre non sia mai cancellato.
text.VUL: In memoriam redeat iniquitas patrum ejus in conspectu Domini, et peccatum matris ejus non deleatur.
text.DRA: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

text.WLC: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְיַכְרֵ֖ת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
text.NEO: Qu’elles soient toujours devant Yahweh, et qu’il retranche de la terre leur mémoire !
text.NAB: May their guilt be always before the LORD, till their memory is banished from the earth,
text.VAT_ES: que estén siempre delante del Señor,
text.CEI: Siano davanti al Signore sempre ed egli disperda dalla terra il loro ricordo.
text.VUL: Fiant contra Dominum semper, et dispereat de terra memoria eorum :
text.DRA: May they be before the lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth:

text.WLC: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ עָנִ֣י וְ֭אֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְמוֹתֵֽת׃
text.NEO: Parce qu’il ne s’est pas souvenu d’exercer la miséricorde, parce qu’il a persécuté le malheureux et l’indigent, et l’homme au cœur brisé pour le faire mourir.
text.NAB: For he did not remember to show kindness, but hounded the wretched poor and brought death to the brokenhearted.
text.VAT_ES: Porque nunca pensó en practicar la misericordia,
text.CEI: Perché ha rifiutato di usare misericordia e ha perseguitato il misero e l'indigente, per far morire chi è affranto di cuore.
text.VUL: pro eo quod non est recordatus facere misericordiam,
text.DRA: Because he remembered not to show mercy,

text.WLC: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵ֑הוּ וְֽלֹא חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה וַתִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
text.NEO: Il aimait la malédiction : elle tombe sur lui ; il dédaignait la bénédiction : elle s’éloigne de lui.
text.NAB: He loved cursing; may it come upon him; he hated blessing; may none come to him.
text.VAT_ES: Amó la maldición: que recaiga sobre él;
text.CEI: Ha amato la maledizione: ricada su di lui! Non ha voluto la benedizione: da lui si allontani!
text.VUL: et persecutus est hominem inopem et mendicum, et compunctum corde, mortificare.
text.DRA: But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; and the broken in heart, to put him to death.

text.WLC: וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃
text.NEO: Il s’est revêtu de la malédiction comme d’un vêtement ; comme l’eau elle entre au-dedans de lui, et comme l’huile elle pénètre dans ses os.
text.NAB: May cursing clothe him like a robe; may it enter his belly like water, seep into his bones like oil.
text.VAT_ES: Se revistió de la maldición como de un manto:
text.CEI: Si è avvolto di maledizione come di un mantello: è penetrata come acqua nel suo intimo e come olio nelle sue ossa.
text.VUL: Et dilexit maledictionem, et veniet ei ; et noluit benedictionem, et elongabitur ab eo. Et induit maledictionem sicut vestimentum ; et intravit sicut aqua in interiora ejus, et sicut oleum in ossibus ejus.
text.DRA: And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him. And he put on cursing, like a garment: and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.

text.WLC: תְּהִי ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃
text.NEO: Qu’elle soit pour lui le vêtement qui l’enveloppe, la ceinture qui ne cesse de l’entourer !
text.NAB: May it be near as the clothes he wears, as the belt always around him."
text.VAT_ES: que sea como un vestido que lo cubra
text.CEI: Sia per lui come vestito che lo avvolge, come cintura che sempre lo cinge.
text.VUL: Fiat ei sicut vestimentum quo operitur, et sicut zona qua semper præcingitur.
text.DRA: May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.

text.WLC: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַי מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְהַדֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל נַפְשִֽׁי׃
text.NEO: Tel soit, de la part de Yahweh le salaire de mes adversaires, et de ceux qui parlent méchamment contre moi.
text.NAB: May the LORD bring all this upon my accusers, upon those who speak evil against me.
text.VAT_ES: Que así retribuya el Señor a mis acusadores,
text.CEI: Sia questa da parte del Signore la ricompensa per chi mi accusa, per chi dice male contro la mia vita.
text.VUL: Hoc opus eorum qui detrahunt mihi apud Dominum, et qui loquuntur mala adversus animam meam.
text.DRA: This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; and who speak evils against my soul.

text.WLC: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗י עֲֽשֵׂה אִ֭תִּי לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
text.NEO: Et toi, Seigneur Yahweh, prends ma défense à cause de ton nom ; dans ta grande bonté, délivre-moi.
text.NAB: But you, LORD, my God, deal kindly with me for your name's sake; in your great mercy rescue me.
text.VAT_ES: Pero tú, Señor, trátame bien,
text.CEI: Ma tu, Signore Dio, agisci con me secondo il tuo nome: salvami, perché buona è la tua grazia.
text.VUL: Et tu, Domine, Domine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum, quia suavis est misericordia tua.
text.DRA: But thou, O Lord, do with for thy names sake: because thy mercy is sweet. Do thou deliver me.

text.WLC: כִּֽי עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝לִבִּ֗י חָלַ֥ל בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃
text.NEO: Car je suis malheureux et indigent, et mon cœur est blessé au-dedans de moi.
text.NAB: For I am sorely in need; my heart is pierced within me.
text.VAT_ES: Porque yo soy pobre y miserable,
text.CEI: Io sono povero e infelice e il mio cuore è ferito nell'intimo.
text.VUL: Libera me, quia egenus et pauper ego sum, et cor meum conturbatum est intra me.
text.DRA: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.

text.WLC: כְּצֵל כִּנְטוֹת֥וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽאַרְבֶּֽה׃
text.NEO: Je m’en vais comme l’ombre à son déclin, je suis emporté comme la sauterelle.
text.NAB: Like a lengthening shadow I near my end, all but swept away like the locust.
text.VAT_ES: me desvanezco como sombra que declina,
text.CEI: Scompaio come l'ombra che declina, sono sbattuto come una locusta.
text.VUL: Sicut umbra cum declinat ablatus sum, et excussus sum sicut locustæ.
text.DRA: I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: and I am shaken off as locusts.

text.WLC: בִּ֭רְכַּי כָּשְׁל֣וּ מִצּ֑וֹם וּ֝בְשָׂרִ֗י כָּחַ֥שׁ מִשָּֽׁמֶן׃
text.NEO: A force de jeûne mes genoux chancellent, et mon corps est épuisé de maigreur.
text.NAB: My knees totter from fasting; my flesh has wasted away.
text.VAT_ES: De tanto ayunar se me doblan las rodillas,
text.CEI: Le mie ginocchia vacillano per il digiuno, il mio corpo è scarno e deperisce.
text.VUL: Genua mea infirmata sunt a jejunio, et caro mea immutata est propter oleum.
text.DRA: My knees are weakened through fasting: and my flesh is changed for oil.

text.WLC: וַאֲנִ֤י הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּנִי יְנִיע֥וּן רֹאשָֽׁם׃
text.NEO: Je suis pour eux un objet d’opprobre ; ils me regardent et branlent de la tête.
text.NAB: I have become a mockery to them; when they see me, they shake their heads.
text.VAT_ES: soy para ellos un ser despreciable,
text.CEI: Sono diventato loro oggetto di scherno, quando mi vedono scuotono il capo.
text.VUL: Et ego factus sum opprobrium illis ; viderunt me, et moverunt capita sua.
text.DRA: And I am become a reproach to them: they saw me and they shaked their heads,

text.WLC: עָ֭זְרֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי כְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
text.NEO: Secours-moi, Yahweh, mon Dieu ! Sauve-moi dans ta bonté !
text.NAB: Help me, LORD, my God; save me in your kindness.
text.VAT_ES: Ayúdame, Señor, Dios mío,
text.CEI: Aiutami, Signore mio Dio, salvami per il tuo amore.
text.VUL: Adjuva me, Domine Deus meus ; salvum me fac secundum misericordiam tuam.
text.DRA: Help me, O Lord my God; save me according to thy mercy.

text.WLC: וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃
text.NEO: Qu’ils sachent que c’est ta main, que c’est toi, Yahweh, qui l’a fait !
text.NAB: Make them know this is your hand, that you, LORD, have acted.
text.VAT_ES: para que sepan que aquí está tu mano,
text.CEI: Sappiano che qui c'è la tua mano: tu, Signore, tu hai fatto questo.
text.VUL: Et sciant quia manus tua hæc, et tu, Domine, fecisti eam.
text.DRA: And let them know that this is thy hand: and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.

text.WLC: יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ וַיֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽעַבְדְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח׃
text.NEO: Eux, ils maudissent ; mais toi, tu béniras ; ils se lèvent, mais ils seront confondus, et ton serviteur sera dans la joie.
text.NAB: Though they curse, may you bless; shame my foes, that your servant may rejoice.
text.VAT_ES: no importa que ellos maldigan,
text.CEI: Maledicano essi, ma tu benedicimi; insorgano quelli e arrossiscano, ma il tuo servo sia nella gioia.
text.VUL: Maledicent illi, et tu benedices : qui insurgunt in me confundantur ; servus autem tuus lætabitur.
text.DRA: They will curse and thou will bless: let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.

text.WLC: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְיַעֲט֖וּ כַמְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃
text.NEO: Mes adversaires seront revêtus d’ignominie, ils seront enveloppés de leur honte comme d’un manteau.
text.NAB: Clothe my accusers with disgrace; make them wear shame like a mantle.
text.VAT_ES: que mis acusadores se cubran de oprobio,
text.CEI: Sia coperto di infamia chi mi accusa e sia avvolto di vergogna come d'un mantello.
text.VUL: Induantur qui detrahunt mihi pudore, et operiantur sicut diploide confusione sua.
text.DRA: Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: and let them be covered with the their confusion as with a double cloak.

text.WLC: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּפִ֑י וּבְת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽנּוּ׃
text.NEO: Mes lèvres loueront hautement Yahweh ; je le célébrerai au milieu de la multitude ;
text.NAB: I will give fervent thanks to the LORD; before all I will praise my God.
text.VAT_ES: Yo daré gracias al Señor en alta voz,
text.CEI: Alta risuoni sulle mie labbra la lode del Signore, lo esalterò in una grande assemblea;
text.VUL: Confitebor Domino nimis in ore meo, et in medio multorum laudabo eum :
text.DRA: I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: and in the midst of many I will praise him.

text.WLC: כִּֽי יַ֭עֲמֹד לִימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
text.NEO: car il se tient à la droite du pauvre, pour le sauver de ceux qui le condamnent.
text.NAB: For God stands at the right hand of the poor to defend them against unjust accusers.
text.VAT_ES: porque él se puso de parte del pobre,
text.CEI: poiché si è messo alla destra del povero per salvare dai giudici la sua vita.
text.VUL: quia astitit a dextris pauperis, ut salvam faceret a persequentibus animam meam.
text.DRA: Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, to save my soul from persecutors.
